inputs.label: Futurama Xbox disc image
inputs.help: An ISO of your own Xbox Futurama disc, NTSC-U or PAL. QGPUI names it futurama.iso on the headset, so its name on the PC does not matter. Give this or the extracted files.

inputs.label: Futurama Xbox disc, extracted
inputs.help: The extracted files of your own Xbox Futurama disc, NTSC-U or PAL: the folder that holds default.xbe. Give this or the disc image.

steps.text: Open Futurama from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for access to files, allow it. The game appears as a 3D window over passthrough, not in first person.

notes: Quest 3 only; early release with frequent updates (v0.1.0 to v0.1.5 in four days). The app looks for an ISO whose name matches *futurama*.iso, or for default.xbe, in /sdcard/Futurama/, /sdcard/Download/ or its Android/data files folder; the push renames the ISO so any name works. The guide says nothing about a storage permission, so no grant step; the tell covers a prompt. freeSpaceMB assumes an untrimmed Redump ISO (about 7.3 GB); a trimmed xiso is much smaller.
